findings.description: AWS access key material is embedded in the Lambda environment variables. Function configuration can be read by principals with Lambda configuration-describe access, and source-controlled credentials should be treated as compromised.
The function uses nodejs12.x, a deprecated Lambda runtime that no longer receives security updates. Known runtime vulnerabilities may remain exploitable in the deployed function.
